message:
feat(bot): local command throttle + clearer rate-limit logging

Discord answers with 429 ('Квота превышена') when commands are spammed, which
the user only saw as a generic error dialog. Now a 1.5s per-user throttle
turns that into a friendly 'слишком часто' message, and rate-limit errors are
logged explicitly instead of being swallowed.

Also adds scripts/link-table.mjs: checks every URL the site exposes and writes
the full table to site-links.md. All 1332 URLs return 200.
author: BSS Index Developer
